title: PCR detection instrument, Chinese parts assembled in Japan
description: A laboratory PCR instrument for in vitro diagnostics. The power supply, main board, monitor, temperature module and the other parts come from China; they are screwed together and wired in Japan. CBP held China (N333453).
notes: One of the families added in D138 (medical devices). Built from the D171 fixture for CBP ruling N333453 (train split, never a test split): the product was drafted by gemini-4-argon from CBP's facts and reviewed by hand; the target plant's capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. Precedents are limited to rulings dated before 2023-07-05, and N333453 itself is excluded. Picked by family, not by result (D191): the first D171 fixture of each of four families. Recorded result (eval/results/planner-families-n333453-litellm.json): the engine said China at 0.98 stated, where CBP held China (it agrees with CBP). First plan shown: "Make PCBA and sensors in Japan", check 0.92 on N330296. That ruling, read by hand: partial (N330296 held Vietnam for a camera whose PCBAs were made in the assembling country; right principle, different product.) A run on this site is a new run and may differ.

product.name: QuantGene 9600 Fluorescent Quantitative Detection System (FQD-96C)
product.description: An automated standalone in vitro diagnostic instrument used for quantitative detection of analytes in pathogen nucleic acids from human samples using the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) process. It consists of a power supply, support, fixing plate, power supply switch, main printed circuit board, monitor, guide rail assembly, temperature control module, wires, and external components.

operations.name: Attach power supply to support with screws
Press power supply fixing plate against power supply switch and affix with glue
Fasten main board to the device with screws
Attach monitor with screws and plug wires into allocated slots
Power on monitor, verify serial number display, and slide guide rail assembly together with temperature control module fastened with screws and glue
Press all wires into place on the main printed circuit board
Fasten external components with screws and zip tie wires in place
